name: Research and write
about: One research card per question (separate questions with ;), each writing a note in docs/research/, then one card folds the answers into a document.

vars.questions: What does an idle Claude Code session that waits on Monitor cost per hour?; How do other VS Code extensions run tasks that depend on each other?

steps.title: Research: {{question}}
steps.reply: the answer's first paragraph and the note's path

steps.title: Fold the answers into {{document}}
steps.goal: The research notes of this plan are merged into your branch under docs/research/. Add a short section to {{document}} for each: the question, the answer's first paragraph, and a link to the note. Change nothing else.
steps.reply: the commit id and the sections added
